pr.title: Resurrect left-pad@1.3.0: replace with String.prototype.repeat
pr.body:
## 🪦 left-pad@1.3.0 → Replace route

**Why this package:** risk 58/100, status **deprecated**.
- Deprecated by its author
- Source repository is archived
- No release for 8.6 years
- Imported at 2 sites in 2 files
- Author's deprecation notice: "use String.prototype.padStart()"

**Coroner's verdict:** A maintained replacement exists: String.prototype.repeat. Pad with built-in string methods instead of the deprecated left-pad. 2 candidates will be proven against the original before any change is kept.

### What changed
- Added `graveyard/shims/left-pad.cjs`: String.prototype.repeat, repeating the pad string once per missing character like the original
- Rewrote 2 imports in 2 files: `src/format.js`, `src/receipt.mjs`
- Removed `left-pad` from package.json and package-lock.json
- The public API of this project is unchanged: callers keep the same function names and arguments.

### Proof
fast-check generated inputs and ran each one through **both** the original `left-pad@1.3.0` and the new code. Every output had to be deep-equal (or both had to throw the same error type).

| Property | Runs | Result |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| pads like left-pad for any string, length and pad character | 500 | ✅ agree |

500 generated inputs, seed `20261031`, 49 ms. Ran in a Node.js permission-model sandbox: read-only file access, no child processes, empty environment.

#### Attempts
1. ❌ **padStart**: String.prototype.padStart, as the deprecation notice suggests. Rejected after 3 inputs.
   Counterexample `[0,2,false]`: original returns `" 0"`, candidate returns `"f0"`.
2. ✅ **repeat-exact**: String.prototype.repeat, repeating the pad string once per missing character like the original. Agreed on all 500 inputs.

### Replay test (stays in the repo)
40 recorded cases in `graveyard/proofs/left-pad.golden.json`, replayed by `graveyard/proofs/left-pad.proof.test.js` with `node --test`: ✅ pass. They keep guarding the behaviour after the original package is gone.

Project tests (`npm test`): ✅ pass

### Risk note
- Equivalence is proven on generated inputs within the documented API, not on every possible value. Pad with built-in string methods instead of the deprecated left-pad.
- padStart truncates multi-character pads and pads with "false"/"null" text; the original repeats the pad and treats falsy pads as a space, so this does too.

### Provenance
- Original: `left-pad@1.3.0` (installed copy, matching the lockfile version)
- Integrity: `sha512-XI5MPzVNApjAyhQzphX8BkmKsKUxD4Ldy…`
- Licence: WTFPL (no original code is copied)
- Recipe: `left-pad-native`, candidate `repeat-exact`

### Reviewer checklist
- [ ] The rewritten imports are the only call sites
- [ ] The risk note matches how this project uses the package
- [ ] CI passes

_Opened by Graveyard Shift. The Coroner chose the route, the Surgeon made the change, the proof decided. A human reviews and merges; nothing is published automatically. After merge, a Warden keeper bot watches this package for new advisories._
